name: Martin Wills Fund
summary: Grants for small and medium-sized charities in the UK and Ireland running projects that protect, restore and enhance wildlife and habitats, with a yearly application window.

calls.label: Application window
calls.recurring: Applications open 1 April to 31 August; decisions in early December

status.quote: PLEASE NOTE: applications for the Martin Wills Fund are open from 1st April to the 31st August.

recurring.quote: PLEASE NOTE: applications for the Martin Wills Fund are open from 1st April to the 31st August. Applications are reviewed and decisions made in early December, with grants being paid out to successful applicants between 1 December - 31 March.

applicant_types.quote: We support: Charities registered and working in the UK and Ireland Small and medium-sized organisations with an annual income under £5 million

geography.quote: The Martin Wills Fund provides grants of £5,000-£20,000 to small and medium-sized charities working in the UK and Ireland for projects that protect and restore wildlife and habitats.

window.quote: PLEASE NOTE: applications for the Martin Wills Fund are open from 1st April to the 31st August.
